Please note: this product is Shed and Fence Stain, not paint.

Fortress 9Ltr Golden Oak Shed and Fence Stain offers robust protection and a rich finish for outdoor timber structures. This water-based, quick-drying formulation is ideal for tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts treating rough sawn garden wood, including sheds, fences, and pergolas. It provides excellent moisture resistance and a distinctive golden oak colour, enhancing the aesthetic appeal of any outdoor space. The stain is showerproof in just one hour and dries completely in four hours, allowing for efficient project completion. It is easy to clean and boasts a low odour, ensuring a more pleasant application experience for large areas.
